caption: Figure 4: FuseLink architecture in a GPU server with four parallel GPU workers and four NICs. W0 is using both NIC 0 and NIC 1 for inter-server communication when W1 is not sending any trafﬁc. W0 sending buffers are mapped to GPU0 and GPU1 for efﬁcient data transmission
